name: Almonds

pros.title: has a more specific food identity
pros.explanation: There is a reason it earns attention beyond the basic role.

pros.title: brings a clearer food story
pros.explanation: That extra identity helps it stand out in the category.

pros.title: portable whole-food fat snack
pros.explanation: They are easy to use without turning into a more processed snack.

cons.title: portions are easy to overshoot
cons.explanation: Dense or snackable formats punish casual serving sizes.

cons.title: not enough extra payoff for a top slot
cons.explanation: The wider food still has to earn its place through more than one angle.

cons.title: tree-nut allergy limits use
cons.explanation: For some people, almonds are simply not a usable option.

identity.basisReason: Raw per-100g edible-kernel basis matches plain almond comparison and avoids salted, roasted, or sweetened variants.
